purpose: Sanitized public source package for the UIS8910-SDR v0.1 repository. Not a license grant; third-party redistribution terms remain separately disclosed.
external_dependencies: Windows firmware build includes pinned ARM/SDK subset archives and the v0.1 platform PAC. These inputs require vendor/license/source-compliance review before public upload; no permission is inferred from this local package.

Host EXE/DLL releases and frozen historical records are omitted. The v0.1 PAC is explicitly included because firmware packaging preserves vendor CP/RF/boot/NV from it.
Linked local-only research records are enumerated in EXPORT-REVIEW.json; publication reviewers must decide which additional final summaries are cleared.
